dsl: Because(Rated(Blunder), Allows([Qxf2+], And([WinMaterial([Pawn]), After([Kh1, Qxg3], WinMaterial([Pawn]))])))
english: 28.g3 is a blunder: White allows 28...Qxf2+, after which Black wins a pawn, and after 29.Kh1 Qxg3, Black wins a pawn.

dsl: Because(Rated(Blunder), And([Allows([Qxf2+, Kh1, Qxg3], And([WinMaterial([Pawn, Pawn]), Degree(Decisive, Pressure(KingZone { opponent: true }))])), Instead(Rd1, Allows([Qxf2+], WinMaterial([Pawn])))]))
english: 28.g3 is a blunder: White allows 28...Qxf2+ 29.Kh1 Qxg3, after which Black wins two pawns and decisively puts pressure on the squares around White's king, and with 28.Rd1 instead, White allows 28...Qxf2+, after which Black wins a pawn.
